Lessons.Title: Amplitude and Midline
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Create a trigonometric function to represent a situation where either the amplitude or midline is not 1. Describe (in writing) how changing the amplitude or midline transforms the graph of a trigonometric function.
For y=A sin(x)+D, amplitude |A| is half the peak-to-trough distance and midline y=D is average of max and min. Negative A reflects vertically, not change amplitude magnitude.
